text:
incident-bot: Canary alert · group="edge" · rollout=v1.3.7 · metric=5xx_rate · value=4.8% (threshold=4% over 5m). p95 latency +120ms. Abort criteria met for canary review (auto-kill requires 6m). Link: https://internal.redwood/alerts/6123456789

dave_oncall: ack — I'm on it. Paging infra. @ben_infra can you check edge node pool and recent deploys?

ben_infra: looking now. I see two deploys as part of the wave: edge-proxy and tokenizer. Grabbing logs and container statuses.

megan_prod: noticed CS flagged spike in 502s from EU customers ~10:12UTC, correlates with this alert. FYI.

carlos_sre: @dave_oncall hold the rollout if possible. Recommend feature-flag kill-switch until we triage. I can run a quick diff of frontdoor vs canary paths.

dave_oncall: holding rollout. initiating feature-flag rollback now. deploy-bot: rollback canary:v1.3.7 -> v1.3.6 (manual kill-switch)

deploy-bot: rollback initiated by dave_oncall. Command: `/rollback canary edge to v1.3.6` · estimated completion ~2m · status=running

ben_infra: quick scan shows tokenizer containers on node edge-12 had OOMs starting 2025-03-12T10:13:52Z, restart loop observed. Posting sample logs:
```
2025-03-12T10:13:52Z tokenizer[pid=4221]: ERROR: runtime: out of memory allocating vector (size 78MB)
2025-03-12T10:13:53Z kubelet: BackOff restarting failed container
2025-03-12T10:13:54Z proxy[edge-12]: 502 from tokenizer svc when calling /tokenize (conn reset)
```

dave_oncall: that looks like a memory regression in v1.3.7 tokenizer component. @carlos_sre any KV cache evictions or pressure?

carlos_sre: KV cache miss rate up x3 during spike, but no corruption. Eviction count increased on node edge-12. Scaling tokenizer pool +1 and bumping memory limit as temporary mitigant.

megan_prod: CS report: after ~30–90s post rollback start, customer errors dropped — some EU customers still saw intermittent 502s but below alert threshold now. I'll notify affected accounts.

ben_infra: rollback finished. All canary pods reported v1.3.6. Health checks green across canary group. Monitoring for 10m.

incident-bot: Alert resolved — 5xx rate returned below threshold. Summary: suspected root cause tokenizer memory regression introduced in v1.3.7 causing OOM restarts -> 502 cascade to edge-proxy. Mitigation: rollback to v1.3.6 + temporary pool scale. Follow-up: create postmortem + regression test for tokenizer memory.

dave_oncall: creating postmortem ticket and assigning to @ben_infra and @carlos_sre for RCA and a regression test. Can someone take ownership of a temporary post-deploy healthcheck for tokenizer?

carlos_sre: I'll own the post-deploy healthcheck and add memory/heap smoke tests to the CI job.

megan_prod: I'll coordinate customer comms and update CS notes. :thumbsup:

dave_oncall: thanks all. I am closing on-call handoff for this incident. If anything reappears ping me. :eyes:
